name: periodic components
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 不平顺信号中具有周期性变化的成分。
usage_overview: 用于表征轨道不平顺在特定空间尺度上重复出现的变化。这类成分在谱中形成局部峰值，可据此将不平顺的重复性特征与相应空间尺度联系起来。

complete_examples.text: The first model is a new mathematical track spectrum function with consideration of the periodic components.
The characterization with physical significance is highly important for track irregularities with periodic components.
